Too easily provoked? Yes. Overreactive, but…''"
"''Understatement.''"
"''Says what he means.|Slorda and Teenar|audio=Slorda-Teenar-Narkina5.flac|}} '''Slorda''' was a [[human]] who attended a party at the [[Chandrilan Embassy]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]] in [[5 BBY]]. At the party he spoke with [[Senator]]s [[Mon Mothma]], [[Dhow]], [[Teenar]], and [[Vivyn]] about the [[Galactic Empire]]'s new [[Public Order Resentencing Directive]], but he was unconcerned with the increase in Imperial surveillance and arrests that the directive caused. ==Biography== {{Quote|Do you feel under threat?''"
"''Personally? Here, yes. I'm at great risk of ingesting too much of this nourishing Chandrilan hospitality.|Mon Mothma and Slorda|audio=Mothma-Slorda-Narkina5.flac|}} [[File:EmbassySenators-Narkina5.png|thumb|right|300px|Slorda attended a party at the Chandrilan Embassy.]] Slorda was a [[human]] who attended a party in the [[Chandrilan Embassy]] on the [[planet]]''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' [[Coruscant]] in [[5 BBY]].{{AndorDate|108}} The party took place shortly after [[Galactic Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] introduced the [[Public Order Resentencing Directive]] in response to a [[Aldhani rebel infiltration team|rebel]] [[Aldhani heist|heist]] on the planet{{Andor|The Eye}} [[Aldhani]]. [[Chandrilan]] [[Senator]] [[Mon Mothma]] hoped to gain votes against the directive at the party and spoke with Slorda and Senators [[Dhow]], [[Teenar]], and [[Vivyn]]. During the conversation, Slorda agreed that Palpatine was frustrating, overreactive, and too easily provoked, but he countered that the [[Emperor]] also spoke his mind and that citizens had nothing to fear from the directive's increase in surveillance and arrests as long as they had done nothing wrong. He agreed with Vivyn that they were living in dangerous [[time]]s, but when pressed on the subject by Mothma, he changed the topic with a joke about being in danger of ingesting too much of the drink available at the party. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Surveillance and prosecution without limit.''"
"''If you're doing nothing wrong, what is there to fear?|Teenar and Slorda|audio=Teenar-Slorda-Narkina5.flac|}} Slorda had light skin, gray [[eye]]s, and gray [[hair]]. He seemed unconcerned by the increases in Imperial oversight brought about by the Emperor's new directive. ==Equipment== During the party, Slorda wore dark [[Color|blue]] robes with a matching [[hat]], a golden [[necklace]], and a golden [[ring]] on the ring [[Limb|finger]] of his right hand. ==Behind the scenes== Slorda was portrayed by [[Nicholas Murchie]] in "[[Narkina 5 (episode)|Narkina 5]]," the eighth episode of the [[Andor Season 1|first season]] of the live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', which aired on [[October 26]], [[2022]].{{Twitter|starwars|status/1557442379975573504|[[Star Wars]]|date=2022-8-10|quote=This is what revolution looks like. Watch #Andor, a Star Wars Original Series, streaming only on @DisneyPlus September 21.|archivedate=20220810191942}} The character's name is not spoken in the episode but is given in the subtitles. ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Slorda|soundcat=Audio files of Slorda}} *{{Andor|Narkina 5 (episode)}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Slorda |ka=სლორდა |pl=Slorda }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]]
